---
title: "Summary · Cast the System"
---

## Key takeaways

- **Characters are responsibilities in disguise.** Each character maps to a
  responsibility in the system.
- Dialogue carries the explanation: a conversation between two characters shows a
  responsibility hand-off that the listener can hear.
- Keep the cast **small** (four to six characters) and **distinct** enough for
  audio-only identification.
- Every character must trace back to the mapping in `metaphor.md`. No character
  exists purely for decoration.
- **Breaking the fourth wall** is an optional technique to re-anchor the listener
  to the technical model. Use it sparingly.
- The output is `characters.md` with six fields per character: Character,
  Technical counterpart, Responsibility, Personality, Voice, Relationship.
